fields.name: work_scratch
fields.meaning: Working memory the game uses while running (screen and menu buffers, counters). Not part of a save slot
fields.evidence: changes with almost every step of play; outside the range the save code copies

fields.name: live_game_state
fields.meaning: The game keeps its current game state here in cartridge memory. Saving copies exactly these bytes into a slot; loading copies a slot back here. The layout matches the slot-data rows below (slot 1 data starts at 0x2718)
fields.evidence: code a9e1:0346 (copy to slot), bbfd:011a (copy back); the used slot equals these bytes exactly

fields.name: work_scratch_2
fields.meaning: More working memory (name buffers, pointer tables rebuilt at run time). Not saved
fields.evidence: outside the copied range; cleared and rebuilt by the game setup code

fields.name: slots
fields.meaning: Three save slots of 0x1BD2 bytes: slot 1 at 0x2710, slot 2 at 0x42E2, slot 3 at 0x5EB4. Rows below describe slot 1; the same layout applies to every slot
fields.evidence: code a9e1:00bc and bbfd:0000 (slot base = 0x2710 + n * 0x1BD2); saves recorded in all three slots

fields.name: hdr_year
fields.meaning: Year shown in the save/load list (copy of the game year)
fields.evidence: code a9e1:02e2 (copies the live year), a9e1:0174 (list shows it); 189 on screen

fields.name: hdr_month
fields.meaning: Month shown in the list, stored 0-11 (shown +1)
fields.evidence: code a9e1:02e2, a9e1:017f; stored 0, screen shows month 1

fields.name: hdr_players
fields.meaning: Number of human-controlled rulers; the list notes the extra ones past the first
fields.evidence: code a9e1:02e2 (counts the per-ruler human flags), a9e1:01b6; value 1

fields.name: hdr_ruler_person
fields.meaning: Person number of the current ruler, used to print the ruler name in the list
fields.evidence: code a9e1:0346 (reads it from the ruler officer record), a9e1:018b (name lookup); person 4, shown as Yuan Shu

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of the 0x1BCA data bytes of the slot. Checked when loading; on mismatch the game warns the record may be broken and offers to load it anyway, or clears the slot
fields.evidence: code a9e1:02a5 (compute), a9e1:0346 (store), bbfd:00c0 (verify), bbfd:011a; recomputed over every recorded save: 20 of 20 used slots match

fields.name: slot_data
fields.meaning: Copy of the live game state

fields.name: unknown_0478
fields.meaning: Unknown; a new game zeroes the first and third byte

fields.name: year
fields.meaning: Current game year (a new game starts at 188 and the first turn advances to 189)
fields.evidence: new game writes 188 (8000:80cc), end of turn adds a year when the month wraps (b000:0e0e), officer age is computed from it (a000:76ad); 189 on screen

fields.name: month
fields.meaning: Current month, 0-11 (shown +1)
fields.evidence: new game writes 11 (8000:80d8); each turn adds 1 and wraps at 12 (b000:0dfc)

fields.name: unknown_047f
fields.meaning: Unknown; never written by the new-game setup (0 in saves)

fields.name: ruler_count
fields.meaning: Number of active rulers (15); ruler slot 15 sits empty
fields.evidence: new game writes 15 (8000:80e3); 15 of 16 ruler records are filled

fields.name: unknown_0481
fields.meaning: Unknown; never written by the new-game setup (0 in saves)

fields.name: ruler_param
fields.meaning: Sixteen per-ruler bytes copied from a cartridge table at new game; meaning unknown
fields.evidence: new-game copy loop 8000:80ed; table bytes found in the cartridge

fields.name: officer_ptr_0492
fields.meaning: Pointer to an officer record (an unattached officer in the recorded saves); cleared at new game. Meaning unknown
fields.evidence: new-game clear 8000:813c; value points at officer 150

fields.name: human_flags
fields.meaning: One byte per ruler: nonzero when that ruler is played by a person
fields.evidence: counted into the header player count (a9e1:0320); cleared at new game (8000:814a); only ruler 4 set in the recorded saves

fields.name: ruler_order
fields.meaning: List of 17 pointers to ruler records (probably the turn order); cleared at new game
fields.evidence: values point into the ruler table

fields.name: turn_index
fields.meaning: Probably the position in the turn order (0 at new game, 8 in the recorded saves)

fields.name: unknown_04eb
fields.meaning: Unknown; never written by the new-game setup (0 in saves)

fields.name: current_ruler
fields.meaning: Pointer to the ruler record whose turn it is (ruler 4 here)
fields.evidence: header ruler name is read through it (a9e1:0346); trust display too (a000:a309)

fields.name: officer_focus
fields.meaning: Pointer to an officer record (the ruler officer here); cleared at new game. Probably the officer in focus
fields.evidence: new-game clear 8000:818d; value points at officer 85

fields.name: province_cursor
fields.meaning: Province cursor: the province screen masks off the low 6 bits as a province number; FF at new game, 0x90 here (stale: the focused province is 19)
fields.evidence: province screen code a000:5f61; new-game write 8000:81a0; changes when leaving menus

fields.name: officers
fields.meaning: 215 officer records of 23 (0x17) bytes; officer n at this offset + n * 0x17
fields.evidence: new-game clear 8000:8107; status screen readers a000:75bf..76b4

fields.name: off_next
fields.meaning: Link to the next officer in the same province list, 0 = end of list
fields.evidence: province 19 chains officers 85-92; the second list chains officers with no ruler

fields.name: off_flag_04
fields.meaning: Flag, 0 or 1; set for 19 officers of 8 forces, matching the provinces whose flag_18 is set. Meaning unknown

fields.name: off_int
fields.meaning: Intelligence

fields.name: off_war
fields.meaning: War ability

fields.name: off_charm
fields.meaning: Charm

fields.name: off_force

fields.evidence: matches the owner of the province the officer is listed in

fields.name: off_loyalty
fields.meaning: Loyalty (FF for rulers, shown as ---)

fields.name: off_service
fields.meaning: Years in service (1, or FF for rulers and unattached officers)

fields.name: off_unknown_0c
fields.meaning: Unknown; FFFF for every officer here (probably battle-only data)

fields.name: off_soldiers
fields.meaning: Number of soldiers
fields.evidence: status screen code a000:7691; the province soldier total (170) is the sum over the list

fields.name: off_weapons
fields.meaning: An independent stock, usually the soldier count times 10 (209 of 215; 6 officers of one force differ), probably weapons

fields.name: off_training
fields.meaning: Training

fields.name: off_unknown_13

fields.name: off_person

fields.name: pad_1873
fields.meaning: Padding between the officer and ruler tables, always 0; no setup code writes it
fields.evidence: uniform 0 over every recorded save image

fields.name: rulers
fields.meaning: 16 ruler records of 40 (0x28) bytes; ruler n at this offset + n * 0x28. Ruler 15 is empty
fields.evidence: new-game clear 8000:8117; the turn-order and current-ruler pointers aim into it

fields.name: rul_officer
fields.meaning: Pointer to the ruler officer record
fields.evidence: header ruler name is read through it (a9e1:0346)

fields.name: rul_province

fields.evidence: values point at provinces owned by that ruler

fields.name: rul_officer_2
fields.meaning: Pointer to a second officer (the next record after the ruler officer for 6 rulers, empty otherwise); possibly a deputy. Meaning unknown

fields.name: rul_trust

fields.name: rul_unknown_24

fields.name: provinces
fields.meaning: 41 province records of 33 (0x21) bytes; province n (1-41) at this offset + (n-1) * 0x21

fields.name: prov_next

fields.name: prov_officers

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text KOEI. A slot counts as used only when this matches; refusing a broken slot overwrites it with NULL
